blocks.x: Precision agriculture converts sensing into input savings and yield: soil/weather/crop telemetry, variable-rate practice, agronomy models and machine orchestration. The unit economics are per-hectare, and they clear investment hurdles when engineered honestly. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in variable-rate input planning, yield/quality forecasting, harvest logistics, with agronomy advisory close behind. The paths are busy; the decisions are late. Closing that delay is worth more than any single tool purchase.
Precision Agriculture & Agronomy: the recurring pressure points,

items: Soil/weather/crop telemetry sparse; variable-rate practice guesswork.
Regional forecasts only; quality attributes discovered at intake.
Harvest machine/crew scheduling by phone; windows missed.
Advisory, machine and lab data never join.
Farm OT/office mix; ransomware reaches operations.
